question.html:
A charged particle, P, of charge +68 μC is fixed in space. A second particle, Q, of charge +0.25 μC is held at a distance of 48 cm from P and is then released.

The diagram shows two parallel wires X and Y that carry equal currents into the page.

Point Q is equidistant from the two wires. The magnetic field at Q due to wire X alone is 15 mT.

a The work done to move a particle of charge 0.25 μC from one point in an electric field to another is 4.5 μJ. Calculate the magnitude of the potential difference between the two points. [1]

b.i Determine the force on Q at the instant it is released. [2]

b.ii Describe the motion of Q after release. [2]

c.i On the diagram draw an arrow to show the direction of the magnetic field at Q due to wire X alone. [1]

c.ii Determine the magnitude and direction of the resultant magnetic field at Q. [2]
